children: Overview
China investment advisory platform's interim revenue fell 38.6% yr/yr due to delayed service recognition
Net income attributable to shareholders dropped 96.3% yr/yr
Company repurchased shares during the reporting period
Outlook
Company expects contract liabilities of RMB1,889.4 mln to be recognized as revenue in 2026 and 2027
Company says ongoing expansion of AI and quantitative research will support future business growth
Result Drivers
REVENUE RECOGNITION DEFERRAL – Revenue fell 38.6% as repeat-order services had largely not yet commenced and will be recognized in later periods
CONTRACT LIABILITIES - Co said contract liabilities increased 133.6%, with most to be recognized as revenue in 2026 and 2027
AI AND EXPANSION COSTS – R&D rose 13.7% on AI and big-data investment, while G&A increased 24.9% on new-business hiring and share-based pay

The average consensus recommendation for the financial technology (fintech) peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for JF SmartInvest Holdings Ltd is HK$55.00, about 92.8% above its August 28 closing price of HK$28.52
